title: Great Building for "Putz" decorating!
text: Great Building for "Putz" decorating!. I can't wait to start decorating all of my "putz" architecture! Very Nicely made.

product_metadata.title: Putz Style Little Village Cardboard Church With Steeple
features: ~1 Assembled cardboard Church 2 1/2"wide x 3 3/4" x 7" tall (including steeple, which does comes separate, you add some glue and attach to the roof-use the picture as a guide)
~ Window Frames, fence sections, & roof for above door (optional)
description: Decorate your own Little Village House for Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Valentine's Day, or whatever the occasion. Comes assembled and ready to decorate. An instruction/idea sheet is included to help get you started. Made in USA.
